caricraft.phone.challenge.rules_text: Every %s nights there is a mandatory challenge, and you can bring it forward. That night you can't sleep and zombies, skeletons, spiders and more spawn with armor and weapons. Each night survived raises the level and the mobs keep getting stronger: more health, damage and speed, gear from chainmail to netherite, enchantments and effects. Each night has 3 waves, each harder than the last. Some are elites (they glow, have a name and pay triple) and sometimes they come in hordes. Each mob gives %s Carins plus half its level, and you earn %s more at dawn. When the sun rises, the mobs vanish.
